 Buy Premium Buy Tickets Match Centre Johan Manzambi and Aaron Wan-Bissaka are set to return to contention for Aston Villa against Sunderland but Matty Cash will miss the Premier League clash. 
 Manzambi was unable to feature for Switzerland during the November international break due to a calf injury, yet the attacking midfielder has now returned to training with the rest of his Villa team-mates.
 Right-back Wan-Bissaka has not featured in the club’s last six matches but is also available to face the Black Cats at Villa Park on Saturday (ko 3pm).
 However, Cash has been ruled out due to protocol having sustained concussion while on international duty for Poland against Romania last Saturday.
 Left-back Matteo Ruggeri and midfielder Amadou Onana remain absent due to injury, with the latter expected to return in March or April.
 Speaking at Friday afternoon’s media conference, Unai Emery provided a fitness update.
 “He (Johan) rested because he had some pain, but with us progressively this week he is training normally,” said the Spaniard.
 “So, he is available for tomorrow.”
 Emery added: “Cash is concussion and Amadou Onana and Ruggeri are still out.
 “The other players, they are ready.”
